stealth._doc: Stealthed things (Schleierwards, Nyx seeds, Grimald traps, Lysa wire) stay hidden from the enemy team unless an enemy Siegelward (seal.revealR) or Suchfeuer covers them, or a Spaehfrucht / Nyx R reveal lingers revealLingerS.
